description: On-road Bicycle Pavement Markings is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by BikePGH. A mile by mile breakdown of the on-street bicycle pavement markings installed within the City of Pittsburgh. These include bike lanes, shared lane markings (sharrows), and protected bike lanes. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher BikePGH. Its tags are bicycle, bicycling, bike, bike lanes, infrastructure. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GIF, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2024-07-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
